title: Twilight pursuit pad - evening follow-ups & call rotation
content:
Purpose: quick, messy scratchpad for tonight's twilight push (5pm-8:30pm PT). Goal: squeeze 6 conversations, lock next steps for three mid-funnel opps, clear two stuck trials. This is short-form — actionable bullets, scripts, time windows.

High-level focus:
- Timezone play: US-East morning converts well; west-coast/evening often reaches founders pre-dinner. Use 17:00-20:30 PT window for admin-level calls + late demos.
- Priorities: 1) Close nod for demo scheduling (ACV $75-150k) 2) Re-engage trial users with clear ROI one-pager 3) Calendar-lock POC engineers for next week.

Quick rules (tonight):
- Use short subject lines if emailing: "Quick idea for <company>" or ">10% inference unit cost cut?"
- If no answer after voicemail+email, wait 3 business days then A/B a short case-study.
- For decision makers: ask for the scope and timeline, not tech detail on initial call.

Call rotation (5 blocks) — shotgun style: short opens, book next step, leave note to CS/SE if >engineering ask
Block 1 (5:05pm PT) - 5 min each
  - Satchle Labs (trial live) — contact: Priya Rao, CTO — goal: lock 30-min POC debrief next Tue; ask why KV cache hits low in their logs; if hostile, escalate to Owen.
  - Cloudbento — contact: Marco Diaz, Head of ML — goal: confirm ability to host in EU; send private deployment checklist.
Block 2 (5:40pm PT) - 8 min each
  - NovelHealth — contact: Sarah K, Dir Product — push for can-we-run-in-prod conversation; emphasize SLA and audit trail.
  - VertoRetail — contact: Jordan M, Eng Manager — they asked about quantization tradeoffs; offer quick pairing session with SE on Thu.
Block 3 (6:15pm PT)
  - Archway AI — contact: Devon H (trial gone quiet) — voicemail + follow email (template below).
Block 4 (7:00pm PT)
  - Frostbyte (inbound) — AE intro call, goal: qualify budget & timeline.
Block 5 (7:40pm PT)
  - Triage backlog: voicemail check-ins and CRM cleanup (mark callbacks, update notes).

Voicemail script (20-30s):
  - "Hey <name>, Ryan Chen here from Redwood Inference. Quick note: noticed <company> spinning up trials — I have an idea for a small config change that often improves latency by >20% without code changes. Would love to share — can I grab 20 minutes this week? My calendar link is [short link]. Thanks!"

Email follow-up templates (keep short):
  - Cold/first touch subject: "Small idea for <company>"
    Body: "Hi <name>, quick ping — noticed you mentioned inference cost on X. We helped <peer company> cut per-token cost ~17% via caching + batch tweaks. If interested, 20 mins is all I need to show a quick before/after. When's good? — Ryan"
  - Trial re-engage subject: "Quick debrief on your trial results"
    Body: "Hi <name>, noticed your trial ran a few tests but stalled. Two quick wins you can try now: (1) enable prefix cache for repeat prompts, (2) set dynamic batch target to 0.5s. Want to hop on a 15-min call? I can pull logs with you. — Ryan"

Notes on open opportunities (one-liners)
  - NovelHealth (pipeline stage: evaluate) — budget not set; legal wants SOC2 before pilot. Action: loop security with CS; send SOC2 + compliance brief.
  - Satchle Labs (pilot) — eng likes latency numbers, need Exec sign-off. Action: schedule 15-min ROI run-through for CTO + CFO.
  - Frostbyte (discovery) — product-led story; ask about 3-month adoption metrics they expect.

Objections cheat-sheet (short)
  - "Too expensive" -> "Let's model cost with your token mix; many customers see net cost neutral after caching/quantization adjustments."
  - "We already have infra" -> "Totally — we can do dedicated/private or hybrid; we help standardize rollout + reduce ops overhead."
  - "Security concerns" -> "We have KMS/HSM integrations and audit logs + SOC2 artifacts I can share."

Admin TODOs (end of night)
  - [ ] Log all call outcomes in CRM with 2-line note (what was asked, next step)
  - [ ] Create a short metrics snapshot for Satchle: latency numbers + cost delta by config (use template in Confluence link)
  - [ ] Send SOC2 + compliance one-pager to NovelHealth (attach via secure link)
  - [ ] Move Archway AI to nurture if no response by Fri EOD

Random brain-dump (ideas to try next week):
  - Run an "evening push" A/B test: email at 6:30pm PT vs 9:00am ET; measure reply rate + meeting conversion.
  - Create a 1-slide cheat for SEs: "3 quick config knobs to cut token cost" — hand to CS during pilot kickoff.

Quick links I referenced tonight:
  - SOC2 + compliance bundle: https://s3.redwood.internal/compliance/soc2-bundle-2026.pdf
  - Deal playbook (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SALES/Deal+Playbook
  - My calendar (short): https://cal.redwood.ai/ryan-20

End of night win metrics: note 3 quick wins here after finishing — fill before sleeping.
  - WIN 1: _____
  - WIN 2: _____
  - WIN 3: _____

Notes to self: breathe, keep calls short, push for commitments (time/date), escalate technical blockers to Owen or SE team right away.

-- Ryan
